items.name: Louisiana data center campus Venture (Hyperion)
items.structure: Unconsolidated VIE; Meta holds 20%, partner funds the rest. Meta leases the campus back.
quotes: The parties have committed to fund their respective pro rata share of approximately $ 27 billion in total estimated development costs.
Our maximum exposure to loss related to the Venture was $ 45.95 billion as of December 31, 2025
with each property having an initial four-year lease term and options to renew for a total lease period of up to 20 years
